stage0087_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Is that the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s black hole...」

stage0087_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Ultra-gravity hasn't been confirmed,
　but it shows every other trait
　of a black hole」

stage0087_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The mystery of the universe...
　So this is the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s power」

stage0087_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$グーラ$$
「That black hole is the true form
　of my father, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$」

stage0087_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$グーラ$$
「My father is the black hole itself.
　Even gravity bends to his will」

stage0087_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see...
　$$オリジン・ロー$$... $$次元力$$, is it」

stage0087_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Hoh... seems you have a little knowledge」

stage0087_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This much is just a dimensional
　trader's basic decorum, $$ロビー$$」

stage0087_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... that type is quite rare.
　I've heard it was meant to record
　a civilization swallowed by a black hole」

stage0087_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$タケル$$
「Don't tell me, that guy is...!?」

stage0087_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$ロビー$$
「That's right, Earthling.
　My homeworld was destroyed
　by Lord $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$」

stage0087_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ロビー$$
「That's why I know better than anyone
　the might of Lord $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$,
　one with $$次元力$$ itself」

stage0087_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ロビー$$
（Yes...
　That's why I'm biding my time,
　watching for my chance...）

stage0087_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「That robot...!
　Is he serving the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　out of fear!」

stage0087_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$グーラ$$
「There's nothing strange about it.
　My father simply holds that much power」

stage0087_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Those who defy my father
　will be punished by me,
　$$グーラ$$, the Demon Beast Prince」

stage0087_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$!
　Are you really saying you'll fight!」

stage0087_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Enough, $$正太郎$$!
　I am the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son...
　the Demon Beast Prince!」

stage0087_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$グーラ$$
「My father gave me one last chance.
　A chance to bury you all right here!」

stage0087_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, hey, $$グーラ$$!
　Cut it out already!
　$$正太郎$$ is...」

stage0087_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Stop, $$ワッ太$$!
　That's for me to say!」

stage0087_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「You're my friend!
　That's why I'll fight you!」

stage0087_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Well said, $$正太郎$$!
　Then let's settle this here!」

stage0087_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「$$タケル$$, isn't there anything
　we can do!? $$正太郎$$ is...」

stage0087_04:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$n
「$$正太郎$$...
　We'll handle the small fry around us」

stage0087_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Here I come, $$グーラ$$!
　I'll say goodbye to you, right here!」

stage0087_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$タケル$$
「So he couldn't escape his fate
　as the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son...」

stage0087_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Next time we meet, leave your sword behind...」

stage0087_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You've done it now, Earth brat!」

stage0087_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$!
　I can still fight!」

stage0087_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I am the Demon Beast Prince!!」

stage0087_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$タケル$$
「So he couldn't escape his fate
　as the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s son...」

stage0087_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Next time we meet, leave your sword behind...」

stage0087_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You've done it now, Earth brat!」

stage0087_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$竜馬$$
「So, you finally crawled out, huh!」

stage0087_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Foolish Earthlings.
　You've really done it,
　taking out my son $$グーラ$$」

stage0087_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$シン$$
「So you mean to avenge $$グーラ$$!」

stage0087_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$正太郎$$ tried to avoid fighting
　$$グーラ$$ right to the end!
　Blaming him is barking up the wrong tree!」

stage0087_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Besides, if you loved $$グーラ$$
　that much, why didn't you
　come save him!」

stage0087_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「To survive in the cosmos,
　one must seize victory
　with one's own hands」

stage0087_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$グーラ$$ knew it well.
　That only the strong survive
　in the cosmos. That's the truth of the universe」

stage0087_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You're saying you chose that
　truth of the universe over
　the bond between father and son!」

stage0087_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$カグラ$$
「So you abandoned your own child!
　Real fine Demon King you are!」

stage0087_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「All living things fight to survive...」

stage0087_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「On that day, 12,000 years ago,
　as the universe collapsed, I sent my son
　$$グーラ$$ to that blue star by dimensional transfer」

stage0087_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「So that's why $$グーラ$$ was on Earth...!」

stage0087_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「The universe's collapse
　12,000 years ago... don't tell me...!?」

stage0087_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That's right. The end of the
　12,000-year cycle... The universe
　I was in could not escape its fated collapse」

stage0087_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「But that day... I climbed
　the stairway to godhood, and became
　one with the black hole closing in」

stage0087_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「To think such a thing is possible...!」

stage0087_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That's right. My will gathered
　people's spirit particles and mastered
　the black hole, a mass of negative $$オリジン・ロー$$」

stage0087_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「I see. If a star's power
　is positive $$次元力$$, then...」

stage0087_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then a black hole, the remains
　of a dead star, is the opposite...
　negative, is it」

stage0087_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$n
「Are you saying he held back
　the universe's collapse
　through sheer force of will...!」

stage0087_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「And to think, a man-made
　$$スフィア・リアクター$$ who doesn't grasp
　the true essence of $$オリジン・ロー$$」

stage0087_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「The power of will moves spirit particles.
　That is what controls $$次元力$$」

stage0087_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$アムロ$$
「True, every $$スフィア・リアクター$$
　we've met so far
　had a strong will」

stage0087_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$キラ$$
「Setsuko, the '$$悲しみの乙女$$',
　$$ランド$$, the '$$傷だらけの獅子$$',
　Crowe, the 'Wavering Scales'...」

stage0087_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$アイム$$ Liard, the '$$偽りの黒羊$$',
　$$ユーサー$$ $$インサラウム$$, the '$$尽きぬ水瓶$$'...」

stage0087_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「And then, $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$,
　the 'Bickering Twins'...」

stage0087_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「They activate their $$スフィア$$s
　to draw out $$次元力$$, while I
　control the black hole, $$次元力$$ itself...」

stage0087_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「And I shall claim Earth, the finest
　wellspring of $$次元力$$, and become
　true eternity!」

stage0087_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$タケル$$
「So you're after Earth's $$次元力$$ too!」

stage0087_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$赤木$$
「Is that why you sent $$グーラ$$ to Earth!」

stage0087_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$グーラ$$ was defeated. He never
　climbed the stairway to godhood.
　One so weak has no right to live!」

stage0087_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Only ruin awaits the weak!!」

stage0087_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ダンカン$$
「L-Lord $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　Even me!!」

stage0087_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Does the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ intend to
　destroy everyone here but himself!」

stage0087_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$タケル$$
「His power keeps rising!
　At this rate...!」

stage0087_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We won't let that happen!
　Not while we're here!!」

stage0087_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Earth brat who felled $$グーラ$$!
　You and that puppet
　cannot be allowed to exist!」

stage0087_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（Why...!?
　Why does the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ view
　$$鉄人$$ as an enemy...!?）

stage0087_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
（Is that the key
　to defeating him...?）

stage0087_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I shall show you a fraction
　of my power... the power of one
　who rules $$次元力$$!」

stage0087_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$隼人$$
「Damn him!
　He's using the black hole as a gate
　to summon the $$インベーダー#keyword$$!」

stage0087_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「The power to rule even $$バアル$$...!
　This is the power of the one
　who calls himself the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0087_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Now, surrender, Earthlings!
　Hand over that blue planet to me,
　and serve me!」

stage0087_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We will never forgive evil!
　No matter who it is...
　no matter how strong!」

stage0087_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We fight evil to protect
　the peace of Earth!」

stage0087_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Then die, Earthlings!
　And in the truth of the universe,
　know your own powerlessness!」

stage0087_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Not bad, Earthling.
　Fitting, for one who lives in the age of the sun.」

stage0087_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$n
「The age of beasts, water, wind, fire,
　and finally, the age of the sun...」

stage0087_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　Just what do you know!?」

stage0087_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Everything in the universe.
　I have even touched the 《$$黒の英知$$》
　that lay within the black hole.」

stage0087_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$葵$$
「I knew it, he had it too!」

stage0087_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's said to grant power and knowledge
　to whoever obtains it.」

stage0087_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「It exists in every parallel world, beyond the walls of dimension.」

stage0087_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$カレン$$
「The annoying part is,
　whoever gets their hands on it is usually a villain!」

stage0087_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「So it seems you call the powerful 'evil.'」

stage0087_04:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$赤木$$
「Someone who runs wild with power
　could never be a hero of justice!」

stage0087_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Then I'll silence you all,
　with my overwhelming power!」

stage0087_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「The $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ was already a fearsome foe,
　and now there are three of him...!」

stage0087_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Offer your spirit particles up to me.」

stage0087_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$シン$$
「This has to be a bluff!」

stage0087_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「So the first one is the real deal,
　and the other two are fakes!」

stage0087_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「You're... the robot that was with $$グーラ$$!」

stage0087_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ロビー$$
「My name is $$ロビー$$.
　For a hundred years since my homeworld was destroyed...
　I have waited for this chance at revenge.」

stage0087_04:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$ロビー$$
「This isn't betrayal!
　I never once swore loyalty to the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!」

stage0087_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You spineless robot.
　Riding on the Earthlings' coattails to defy me?」

stage0087_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Earthlings!
　Every one of those $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$s is real!」

stage0087_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ロビー$$
「Having completed its evolution, the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
　holds multiple lives within itself!」

stage0087_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ロビー$$
「And each of them sustains the others!」

stage0087_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$赤木$$
「So... what are we supposed to do!?」

stage0087_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ロビー$$
「It takes him a full minute to share his life force!
　Which means we have only one minute
　to take down all three $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$s in a row!」

stage0087_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ロビー$$
「If even one is left standing,
　he'll revive the other two after a minute!」

stage0087_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ロビー$$
「And the last key to defeating the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$s
　is the positive... to counter his negative force...」

stage0087_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That's as far as you go, $$ロビー$$!」

stage0087_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ロビー$$
「I-I'm counting on you, Earthlings...!
　Avenge my homeworld!!」

stage0087_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$甲児$$
「He... he staked his life
　to tell us the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s weakness!」

stage0087_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「We can't let his sacrifice be in vain!」

stage0087_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$アルト$$
「Let's go, everyone!
　We're taking down all three $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$s!!」

stage0087_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「It changes nothing, even if you've learned that much.」

stage0087_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I am immortal... I am eternal.」

stage0087_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Mere Earthlings cannot defeat me.」

stage0087_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We will never give up!
　We will defeat you and protect the Earth, I swear it!」

stage0087_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$ミサト$$
「I'm worried about our remaining energy too!
　All units, focus your attacks on the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$s!」

stage0087_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「If we don't take down all three $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$s at nearly
　the same time, he'll revive!」

stage0087_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$タケル$$
「Here we come, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　I'll show you the strength of a cornered human!」

stage0087_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　We're taking down the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!!」

stage0087_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Y-you wretch...!
　Damn you Earthlings!!」

stage0087_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Y-you wretch...!
　Damn you Earthlings!!」

stage0087_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Y-you wretch...!
　Damn you Earthlings!!」

stage0087_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「We did it!
　We beat the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!!」

stage0087_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$n
「Don't celebrate yet!
　The black hole hasn't disappeared!」

stage0087_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What's going on!?
　Did that robot lie to us!?」

stage0087_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「His multiple lives
　were inside that black hole!」

stage0087_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$カトル$$
「Then as long as that black hole exists...!」

stage0087_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$デュオ$$
「You mean he'll just keep coming back!?」

stage0087_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「So the black hole is his true form!」

stage0087_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「But what do we do!?
　Making a black hole disappear, of all things...!」

stage0087_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Could it be... what $$ロビー$$ said at the end...?」

stage0087_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「The positive force that cancels out
　the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s negative force...」

stage0087_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If the black hole is negative $$次元力$$,
　then the positive force is...」

stage0087_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$タケル$$
「The power of the sun...!
　That's...!」

stage0087_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$'s solar energy converter...!
　If we open it all the way at once...!」

stage0087_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Wait, $$正太郎$$!
　If you do that...!」

stage0087_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$桂$$
「That $$ロビー$$ guy,
　did he lie to us!?」

stage0087_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「His multiple lives
　were inside that black hole!」
